services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.115.1
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Backup Freshness Monitor
# =============================================================================
# Checks that backups are not stale and sends alerts via ntfy if issues found.
# Run via cron on Proxmox: 0 6 * * * /var/lib/vz/snippets/backup-monitor.sh
#
# Exit codes:
#   0 - All backups OK
#   1 - Alert sent (stale or missing backups)
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="/tank/backups/vzdump/dump"
DB_DUMP_DIR="/tank/backups/database-dumps"
NTFY_URL="${NTFY_URL:-http://10.100.5.100:8093/homelab-alerts}"
LOGFILE="/var/log/backup-monitor.log"

# Thresholds in hours
DAILY_THRESHOLD=36    # Alert if daily backups > 36 hours old
WEEKLY_THRESHOLD=192  # Alert if weekly backups > 8 days old

log() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $*" >> "$LOGFILE"
}

send_alert() {
    local priority="$1"
    local title="$2"
    local message="$3"
    local tags="$4"

    log "ALERT [$priority]: $title - $message"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_URL" || log "Failed to send ntfy alert"
}

# Check age of most recent backup file matching pattern
check_backup_age() {
    local pattern="$1"
    local name="$2"
    local threshold_hours="$3"
    local dir="${4:-$BACKUP_DIR}"

    local newest
    newest=$(find "$dir" -name "$pattern" -type f -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)

    if [[ -z "$newest" ]]; then
        send_alert "urgent" "Backup Missing: $name" "No backups found matching $pattern" "warning,backup"
        return 1
    fi

    local age_seconds
    age_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$newest") ))
    local age_hours=$(( age_seconds / 3600 ))

    if [[ $age_hours -gt $threshold_hours ]]; then
        local age_days=$(( age_hours / 24 ))
        send_alert "high" "Stale Backup: $name" "Last backup is ${age_days}d ${age_hours}h old (threshold: ${threshold_hours}h). File: $(basename "$newest")" "warning,backup,clock"
        return 1
    fi

    log "OK: $name - newest backup is ${age_hours}h old ($(basename "$newest"))"
    return 0
}

# =============================================================================
# Main
# =============================================================================

log "Starting backup freshness check"
ALERT_COUNT=0

# Daily backups (should be < 36 hours old)
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-304-*.tar.zst" "Immich (304)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-501-*.tar.zst" "OpenWebUI (501)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-502-*.tar.zst" "n8n (502)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

# Database dumps (should be < 36 hours old)
check_backup_age "immich-postgres-*.sql.gz" "Immich DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "openwebui-*.db" "OpenWebUI DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "n8n-*.db" "n8n DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

# Weekly backups (should be < 8 days old)
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-100-*.tar.zst" "Portainer (100)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst" "Network Services (101)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-200-*.tar.zst" "Traefik (200)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-201-*.tar.zst" "Dashboards (201)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-202-*.tar.zst" "Authelia (202)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-401-*.tar.zst" "Jellyfin (401)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-402-*.tar.zst" "Media Management (402)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-500-*.tar.zst" "Monitoring (500)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

log "Backup check completed: $ALERT_COUNT issues found"

if [[ $ALERT_COUNT -gt 0 ]]; then
    exit 1
fi
exit 0

# Alertmanager Configuration
# Routes alerts to ntfy for centralized notification aggregation

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

# Route tree
route:
  group_by: ['alertname', 'severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  receiver: 'ntfy'

  routes:
    # Critical alerts - immediate notification with high priority
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'ntfy-critical'
      group_wait: 10s
      repeat_interval: 1h

    # Warning alerts - batched notifications with default priority
    - match:
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'ntfy'
      group_wait: 1m
      repeat_interval: 4h

# Inhibition rules
inhibit_rules:
  # Inhibit warning if critical is firing for same alertname
  - source_match:
      severity: 'critical'
    target_match:
      severity: 'warning'
    equal: ['alertname', 'instance']

# Receivers
receivers:
  # ntfy receiver for warnings
  - name: 'ntfy'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy - centralized notification aggregator
      # Discord integration will be configured via ntfy webhook subscription
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority=default&tags=warning,homelab'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10

  # ntfy receiver for critical alerts
  - name: 'ntfy-critical'
    webhook_configs:
      # ntfy with urgent priority
      - url: 'http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts?priority=urgent&tags=rotating_light,critical'
        send_resolved: true
        max_alerts: 10

# Templates for message formatting
templates:
  - '/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl'

        annotations:

        for: 2m

          description: "Proxmox storage {{ $labels.storage }} is above 95% used"

        for: 5m
        labels:

        annotations:

# =============================================================================
# Proxmox Vzdump Pre-Backup Hook Script
# =============================================================================
# Called by vzdump before/after backing up each container.
# Performs database dumps for containers that need consistent backups.
#
# Arguments passed by vzdump:
#   $1 - phase (job-start, job-end, job-abort, backup-start, backup-end, backup-abort)
#   $2 - mode (stop, suspend, snapshot)
#   $3 - vmid (container/VM ID)
#
# To add a new container with pre-backup tasks:
#   1. Add a case in the backup-start section below
#   2. Run: task backup:sync:hook
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

PHASE="$1"
MODE="${2:-}"
VMID="${3:-}"

LOGFILE="/var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"
DB_DUMP_DIR="/tank/backups/database-dumps"

log() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') [$PHASE] VMID=$VMID: $*" >> "$LOGFILE"
}

# =============================================================================
# Database Backup Functions
# =============================================================================

# Immich PostgreSQL (Container ID: 304)
backup_immich_postgres() {
    log "Dumping Immich PostgreSQL..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/immich-postgres-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql.gz"

    if pct exec 304 -- docker exec immich_postgres \
        pg_dump -U immich -d immich --clean --if-exists 2>/dev/null \
        | gzip > "$DUMP_FILE"; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "Database dump completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: Database dump failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "immich-postgres-*.sql.gz" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# OpenWebUI SQLite (Container ID: 501)
backup_openwebui_sqlite() {
    log "Creating OpenWebUI SQLite backup..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/openwebui-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).db"

    # Copy the SQLite database file directly from the LXC container
    # The volume mount puts webui.db at /config/openwebui/webui.db on the LXC host
    if pct pull 501 /config/openwebui/webui.db "$DUMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "SQLite backup completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: SQLite backup failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "openwebui-*.db" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# n8n SQLite (Container ID: 502)
backup_n8n_sqlite() {
    log "Creating n8n SQLite backup..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/n8n-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).db"

    # Copy the SQLite database file directly from the LXC container
    # n8n stores its database at /config/n8n/database.sqlite
    if pct pull 502 /config/n8n/database.sqlite "$DUMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "SQLite backup completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: SQLite backup failed (container may not exist yet)"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "n8n-*.db" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Jellyfin Jellystat PostgreSQL (Container ID: 401)
backup_jellystat_postgres() {
    log "Dumping Jellystat PostgreSQL..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/jellystat-postgres-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql.gz"

    # Jellystat uses postgres:15-alpine with database "jellystat" and user "jellystat"
    if pct exec 401 -- docker exec jellystat-db \
        pg_dump -U jellystat -d jellystat --clean --if-exists 2>/dev/null \
        | gzip > "$DUMP_FILE"; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "Database dump completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: Jellystat database dump failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 4 weeks for weekly backups)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz" -mtime +28 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Logic
# =============================================================================

case "$PHASE" in
    job-start)
        mkdir -p "$DB_DUMP_DIR"
        log "Backup job starting"
        ;;

    backup-start)
        log "Backup starting (mode: $MODE)"

        # Container-specific pre-backup tasks
        case "$VMID" in
            304)
                # Immich - dump PostgreSQL before backup
                backup_immich_postgres || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            401)
                # Jellyfin - dump Jellystat PostgreSQL before backup
                backup_jellystat_postgres || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            501)
                # OpenWebUI - backup SQLite database
                backup_openwebui_sqlite || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            502)
                # n8n - backup SQLite database
                backup_n8n_sqlite || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            *)
                # No pre-backup tasks for this container
                ;;
        esac
        ;;

    backup-end)
        log "Backup completed"
        ;;

    backup-abort)
        log "WARNING: Backup aborted"
        ;;

    job-end)
        log "Backup job completed"
        ;;

    job-abort)
        log "ERROR: Backup job aborted"
        ;;

    *)
        log "Unknown phase: $PHASE"
        ;;
esac

exit 0

# Monitoring LXC - OpenTelemetry + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
# IP: 192.168.1.229
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "OpenTelemetry-based monitoring stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana      = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus   = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma  = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy         = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_otel_grpc = "http://192.168.1.229:4317"
    direct_otel_http = "http://192.168.1.229:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenTelemetry Collector", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "OpenTelemetry HTTP", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## OpenTelemetry Endpoints

**OTLP gRPC:** 192.168.1.229:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** 192.168.1.229:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-otel \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server 192.168.1.229 \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View OTEL collector logs
docker logs -f otel-collector

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "prometheus", "grafana", "otel"]
}

# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    portainer_edge_id      = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_id
    portainer_edge_key     = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "otel_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# Prometheus Configuration

global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
  evaluation_interval: 30s
  external_labels:
    monitor: 'homelab'

# Alerting configuration
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
            - alertmanager:9093

# Rule files for alerts
rule_files:
  - /etc/prometheus/alerts/*.yml

# Scrape configurations
scrape_configs:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Monitoring Stack Self-Monitoring
  # ==========================================================================

  # Prometheus self-monitoring
  - job_name: 'prometheus'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['localhost:9090']

  # OpenTelemetry Collector metrics
  - job_name: 'otel-collector'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['otel-collector:8888']

  # Alertmanager metrics
  - job_name: 'alertmanager'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']

  # Grafana metrics
  - job_name: 'grafana'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['grafana:3000']

  # ==========================================================================
  # Traefik Reverse Proxy Metrics
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'traefik'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['10.100.2.200:8082']
        labels:
          instance: 'traefik'
          lxc_id: '200'

  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Metrics
  # Native Prometheus metrics not yet available in v0.107.70

  # ==========================================================================
  # Immich - Photo Management Metrics

  # Jellyfin - Media Server Metrics
  # Requires: Prometheus plugin installed in Jellyfin

  # Uptime Kuma - Status Page Metrics
  # ==========================================================================
  - job_name: 'uptime-kuma'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['uptime-kuma:3001']
        labels:
          instance: 'uptime-kuma'
    metrics_path: /metrics

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push Notification Metrics
  # NOTE: Disabled - Docker DNS resolves 'ntfy' to external DNS (ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev)
  # instead of container name due to search domain. Low-value metrics anyway.
